english.title: Speeding - exceed temporary 60 mph restriction on a motorway ( road works ) - manned equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding 60 miles per hour, in contravention of a temporary maximum speed restriction imposed by a Local traffic Order, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCAL TRAFFIC ORDER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to the above Local Traffic Order and section 16(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove a motor vehicle
on a motorway
at a speed exceeding 60 mph
exceeding a temporary maximum speed restriction

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(ii) See also offence wording: H6577 - relating to manned equipment.
(iii) The summons MUST indicate the Order No. and the specific location e.g. (at, by or between marker posts No....) etc, on the special road.
(iv) A notice of intended prosecution IS required for this offence.

other.penalty:

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to six penalty points (three on a fixed penalty).

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
